about: C_DATA_SPEC.md v4 3.H.1 Matching: aliases and reason class for every deny entry, written from golden_src/*/rejected.json, the 3.G table, golden_src/forbidden_label_nli.json, the GOLDEN_SPEC.md OHS list, the dev/eval source names, the Decision Index sample manifest names and LICENCE_REGISTER.md section 5/6 only. ohs3/used_sources.json is NOT an input of this file (the program reads it in its own process). Sub-entry = [name, class t|n, reason category, aliases, opts]. Alias prefixes: 'name:' = match only in identifier fields (names, domains, parents), never inside free-text descriptions; 'span:' = force description matching for a short alias; no prefix = span (auto-demoted to name when the compact form is <= 4 characters or a generic word). Versions are kept in aliases (e.g. 'taskmaster 4', 'multiwoz 2.2'), so a version that names a different release never matches another release. opts.scope: dataset (default) | split (only the test/dev/eval items are tainted; replay rows from the train split are kept) | part (a per-item program filter; the dataset itself stays IN).
